svg.font-family: Nunito, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How an LLM writes: one token at a time
svg.desc: Text generation as a loop: the tokens so far go through the decoder stack, which scores every token in the vocabulary; one token is sampled, appended to the input, and the whole process repeats.

g.text: How an LLM writes: one token at a time
Four steps, repeated until the model emits a stop token.
“Pick one, add it to the text.”
